rationale: Changes the intentional stable offline presentation: confirmed unavailability of the marker's own active HA roster fades only glyph/value content, while off/idle/unknown and unavailable foreign sources no longer fade the device. LED strips retain ordinary inactive paint and fade only enabled badge text. This is an owner-approved visible semantic change rather than restoration of stable behaviour; no stored configuration changes.

summary.ru: Недоступность устройства определяется по его собственным сущностям и приглушает только иконку или текст; выключенное устройство сохраняет обычный вид.
summary.en: Device unavailability uses its own entities and dims only icon or text content; powered-off devices retain their ordinary appearance.

golden.reason: Own offline icon/Text/badge content alongside off, unknown, controller and inactive LED controls in the light theme.
The same own-availability decisions and retained shell/frame/LED paint in the dark theme.
